positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Design, develop and launch the next generation of the flagship product of the company. This product supports an organization's risk management strategies across all facets of their business and allow for the rapid and cost effective  development, deployment and on-going support of the risk strategies required to reduce risk, react to legislative changes and increase profitability:
   
◦ Design and develop the base code of the application. Focusing on the GUI design of the user controls and other processes.
◦ Manage and merge source code using git and take part in the build management process (Bamboo)
◦ Troubleshoot issues/tickets (Jira) working with the QA team and release process required by SOC  2 (Service Organization Control 2)
◦ Document features and working with other team members
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Atlassian Bamboo · JSON · C# · XML · HTML · Software Development · Lua · SQL · .NET Framework · C++ · Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF) · JavaScript · Software Engineering · Jira

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Analysis and development of customized platforms designed to meet the evolving risk management needs of companies in a broad spectrum of industries, including banking, credit cards, telecommunications, utilities and insurance:

◦ Development and solving issues of a scorecard monitoring tool where user can carry out different analysis of the data and prepare customized reports. 
 ◦ Development and adding new functionalities of a graphical environment to define the contents of a decision system in terms of data, decisional processes, calculations, scorecards and credit policy rules.
 ◦ Development of a PMML (Predictive Model Markup Language) tracer that shows the state of the data during each step of the scorecard execution.
 ◦ Development of a Transaction Flow Control and integrated debugging engine accross all three components of the company software suite.
 ◦ Development of a Data engine record viewer which gives users the ability to view and modify any data elements during the execution of a transaction in debug mode.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · JSON · C# · XML · HTML · Software Development · Lua · SQL · .NET Framework · jRuby · C++ · JavaScript · Software Engineering · Jira

 ◦ Development of platforms for primary care of IC,EPOC, DMII, HTA and obesity, and medical supervision of patients through kiosks acting as health offices in pharmacies 
◦ Design and development of a platform for the control and management of the materials inventory, medical equipment and operating room personnel.
